name: Longsword
description: A versatile blade favored by knights, paladins, and fighters across the realms. Can be wielded with one or two hands.

name: Shortsword
description: A quick, lightweight blade popular with rogues and rangers for dual-wielding and precision thrusts.

name: Dagger
description: A small blade easily concealed in a boot or cloak, useful in close-quarters melee and as a thrown projectile.

name: Greatsword
description: A massive two-handed weapon capable of delivering crushing, cleaving strikes in the hands of a mighty warrior.

name: Longbow
description: A tall bow crafted from sturdy yew or ash, capable of striking targets at immense distances.

name: Greataxe
description: A vicious, double-bitted axe beloved by barbarians seeking devastating critical hits on the front line.

name: Rapier
description: An elegant dueling blade optimized for agile combatants relying on Dexterity and precision footwork.

name: Shield
description: A sturdy wooden or metal shield strapped to the arm, granting +2 to Armor Class.

name: Leather Armor
description: Lightweight armor constructed from boiled and cured hide, offering protection without hindering stealth.

name: Studded Leather
description: Tough leather reinforced with close-set rivets or spikes of steel, favored by scouts and assassins.

name: Chain Shirt
description: Interlocking metal rings worn between layers of clothing, balancing solid defense with mobility.

name: Half Plate
description: Shaped metal plates covering vital organs, worn over quilted cloth and mail.

name: Chain Mail
description: Heavy interlocking steel rings worn over padded fabric, standard military armor for infantry.

name: Plate Armor
description: The pinnacle of heavy protection, comprising fitted interlocking metal plates covering the entire body.

name: Potion of Healing
description: A magical red liquid that sparkles when agitated. Drinking it or administering it to a creature restores 2d4 + 2 hit points.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
description: A potent curative potion glowing with ruby light. Restores 4d4 + 4 hit points.

name: Potion of Invisibility
description: This potion looks like empty glass, but feels heavy as if full. Drinking it turns you invisible for 1 hour.

name: Bag of Holding
description: This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions, roughly 2 feet in diameter at the mouth and 4 feet deep. It can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet.

name: Cloak of Protection
description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while you wear this cloak (requires attunement).

name: Boots of Elvenkind
description: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are walking on. You also have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on moving silently.

name: Wand of Magic Missiles
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the magic missile spell from it.

name: Ring of Protection
description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while wearing this ring (requires attunement).

name: Thieves' Tools
description: This set of tools includes a small file, a set of lock picks, a small mirror mounted on a metal handle, a set of narrow-bladed scissors, and a pair of pliers. Essential for picking locks and disarming traps.

name: Backpack
description: A leather pack capable of carrying up to 1 cubic foot or 30 pounds of adventurer gear.

name: Rope (Hempen, 50 ft.)
description: 50 feet of sturdy hemp rope, has 2 hit points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check.

name: Torch
description: A wooden stick wrapped in resin-soaked cloth. Burns for 1 hour, providing bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

name: Spellbook
description: Essential for wizards. A leather-bound tome with 100 blank vellum pages suitable for inscribing magical formulas and spells.
